statusHistory.note: REDRAFT FROM ZERO. A previous version of this piece was lost entirely — never committed, swept by a crashed agent's git op (see commit c20151f, 2026-09-01) — so nothing was recovered or reused here. Written via near-write-article. Operator directed the Baixada seasonal push on 2026-09-02, choosing it over the rotation's London turn on near-seo's recommendation; trust 'auto' follows from that direct commission, superseding the earlier 'review' marking in post-plan.md. OPENS A ZERO-COVERAGE MARKET: Near's first Guarujá pin (content/opportunities.md's coverage audit had Guarujá and Bertioga at zero). Byline allora-dai — the LGBTQIAPN+ beat, food-drink category, correct for a queer beach barraca. SEASONAL RATIONALE: opportunities.md ranks baixada-santista-queer #1 with the only hard publish-by window in the queue — spring starts on this coast now, and the 'ahead of the season' angle expires for a year if missed. VERIFIED: Anda Direito (Brazil's LGBTQ+ community place directory) lists the venue as currently open and carries its own self-description, quoted in the body. Address Av. Marechal Deodoro da Fonseca 1522, Pitangueiras, Guarujá-SP 11410-223, and phone +55 13 99773-3751, consistent across Anda Direito and Bendito Guia. SOURCING LIMITATION STATED HONESTLY: the A Tribuna article body and the state tourism pages could NOT be read directly — A Tribuna returned navigation chrome only, plataforma.turismo.sp.gov.br has an expired TLS certificate, turismo.sp.gov.br returned a portal index, and guaruja.sp.gov.br returned 403. The Mapa do Turismo LGBT claim rests on A Tribuna's own headline plus corroborating summaries from Diário do Litoral and the state site; the body attributes it as reported rather than as directly read. The named support points (Barraca da Dhéia on Pitangueiras, Barraca da Márcia É Show on Enseada, Quiosque 39) come from that same reporting. DELIBERATELY NOT PUBLISHED AS FACT: Bendito Guia's opening hours (Mon-Fri 9-18, Sat 9-13) are office hours pasted onto a beach barraca on a weekend-economy beach, and the same listing shows a 5.0 rating from ZERO reviews — flagged as directory noise in the body itself, with a call-ahead instruction instead of invented hours. HERO IMAGE: unresolved, and it is the only gate blocking publish. near-illustrator's tiers were worked in order under the new 2026-09-02 directive: photo-inbox is empty (README only); there is NO official website for this venue, only Instagram @barracadadheia, whose CDN URLs expire and are not licence-clear, so tiers 1 and 2 are genuinely unavailable rather than skipped. Falls to tier 3 illustration; generation tooling is unavailable this session, so a self-contained prompt is queued in content/photo-requests.md per the standing fallback. LOCALES: not written — full-locale-coverage does not require localizing a draft, and holding them until the hero resolves avoids redoing six files if the piece shifts. Coordinates are a manual approximation for the Pitangueiras beachfront at Av. Mal. Deodoro da Fonseca 1522 (confidence 0.6, meets the gate).

Flipped to active. Hero resolved at TIER 2 (licensed stock), not the queued tier-3 illustration: operator's call 2026-09-02 to use a generic rainbow-flag/clear-sky image when nothing venue-specific is licence-clear. Selected Ludovic Bertron's 'Rainbow flag and blue skies' (2008, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons), inspected before use — backlit flag against sky, no people, no legible text, crops cleanly to 16:9. licenseNote states plainly it is NOT a photo of the venue, and strategy is 'stock' rather than 'source' precisely because 'source' would claim it shows the actual place. The illustration prompt was removed from photo-requests.md as no longer needed. All six locales written and every gate checked explicitly. Locale editions differ genuinely rather than translating: es-419 adds a Guarulhos/Congonhas-to-Santos-to-ferry route and a carry-cash warning because beach-stall card terminals are unreliable; zh-CN carries the same practical guidance plus navigate-by-address; es-ES trims visitor scaffolding and uses Spain-specific vocabulary (chiringuito); pt-BR, the home market, drops orientation a local would not need. Word/character counts: en 570, es-419 599, es-ES 590, it 531, pt-BR 530, zh-CN 510 word-equivalents (816 CJK chars). Every locale carries the in-text source link to Anda Direito and two NearLinks (Quiosque da Cris, Canto dos Ursos) forming the real three-town coastal circuit.
